spans.s:
dína,
 —1. perhaps adj. clear, in su-dína;
 —2. as n. day. [perhaps ppl. of √dī or
di, ‘shine,’ w. shifted acct.]
dīná, a. scanty; cast down, sad; wretched.

dina-traya, n. day-triad, trīduum, space
of three days.

dīnāra, m. denarius, name of a certain
gold coin. [borrowed fr. Lat. dēnārius, a
silver coin worth ten asses.]
